title: Reading Metadata And Question Model
description: Add explicit reading metadata and a reading-compatible question structure while keeping legacy question/options/answerKey data readable. Wire the additive fields through domain, stores, migrations, GraphQL, client API, and client types.

success: ReadingMaterial exposes band, stage, section, skillFocus, questionType, and scenarioFamily.
Reading questions can represent Matching Headings, Matching Information, TFNG, Summary Completion, Multiple Choice, and Mixed sets.
Existing database rows and current GraphQL clients continue to work.
